title: On the Turán Density of $C_{10}$ in the Hypercube
summary: The $n$-dimensional hypercube $Q_n$ is the graph with vertex set $\{0,1\}^n$ in which two vertices are adjacent if they differ in exactly one coordinate. For a graph $H$, let $\operatorname{ex}(Q_n,H)$ be the maximum number of edges in an $H$-free subgraph of $Q_n$. The hypercube Turán density of $H$ is defined by $π_{\square}(H)=\lim_{n\rightarrow\infty}\operatorname{ex}(Q_n,H)/|E(Q_n)|$.
